title: Compact-support evaluation preserves scalar-adjoint transitions
statement: Let O, t, c, S and B be as above [lem-pur-etale-system-brown-construction, def-pur-coefficient-system-image-data]. For n≤m and an arbitrary derived strict system K on X, let tau^W be the scalar adjunct of its specified strict derived transition. Then F_n(tau^X_K) followed by inverse evaluation c_n equals pi_{m,n} at e_m K, followed by T^Y_{m,n}(c_m inverse), followed by tau^Y_{F_A K}. These are the actual transitions of the ordinary unbounded derived systems, with no flatness or boundedness assumption.

proof.text: Identify the conjugate of derivedTensor with restrictedDirect using restrictedDirect_mate and injectivity of Hom transposition. The iterated-mate identity and properMate then identify the scalar mate of properProjection inverse with restrictedDirect. For inverse image, conjugate the inverse tensor isomorphism and use restrictedInverse_mate and mate injectivity to identify its scalar mate with restrictedInverse.

Transpose directTransition and inverseTransition under their scalar adjunctions. Naturality of the Hom equivalence and cancellation of evaluation isomorphisms give the proper-direct and inverse-image tensor transition equations. Form the natural transformations whose components are scalar adjuncts of the actual transitions. Transpose the entire open evaluation square under the system and level open adjunctions. Mate pasting and naturality with respect to the top and bottom transformations reduce this square to the inverse-image tensor transition equation; use the first component of etaleBrownEvaluationMate and openMate to normalize its right mates.

Apply the proper level functor to the open tensor transition equation, then substitute the proper tensor transition equation. Naturality of properProjection at the inverse open evaluation moves the middle comparison. Expand projection_def and the definition of S.evaluation; functoriality and associativity identify the resulting composite with the claimed equality for the arbitrary unbounded derived object K.

theorem etaleBrownSupportTransition {m n : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m)
    (K : DerivedCategory (strictEtaleCoefficientSystem X O t)) :
    (S.levelFunctor n).map
        (((S.PX.scalar h).derivedAdj.homEquiv _ _).symm ((S.PX.transition h).app K)) ≫
      (S.evaluation n).inv.app K =
    (B.projection h).hom.app ((S.PX.evaluation m).obj K) ≫
      (S.PY.scalar h).derived.map ((S.evaluation m).inv.app K) ≫
      (((S.PY.scalar h).derivedAdj.homEquiv _ _).symm
        ((S.PY.transition h).app (S.functor.obj K)))
